title: mmsyFM 0.1.0
text: Assessment strategies app: rules indicator species, species complexes (pooled biomass CPUE) nominal assignment stocks fleets, compared -stocks rule; defaults ms_assessment_presets(). First version, ported dev-mmsy prototype cpueTargeting combined multispecies MSY app (mmsyapp). Systems: ms_system() four tables; habitat landscape catchability (ms_landscape()); Atlantic example Gulf Thailand draft (atlantic_system(), got_system_draft()). Calibration: ms_tune() (fleet composition open access) ms_condition() (stock status, e.g. 2024 depletions). Stocks: discrete Schaefer exact F/Fmsy (harvest-rate ratio), F cap (persistence floor), JABBA-type process error scaled r depletion, JABBA’s floor process equation. Equilibrium analyses: yield curves, shared-q comparison, safeguarded MMSY (ms_optimise(); total yield, revenue, profit catch one stock). Harvest strategies: hcr_effort() full effort MMSY days, value-weighted weakest-link status, triggers segment, minimum effort, phased annual changes, stock-triggered closures, indicator species, complexes nominal assignment; fixed metier closures (ms_closure()); trigger tuning (ms_tune_hcr()). Performance statistics mseviz format (ms_perf()), boxplots, trade-offs colour-coded decision tables (plot_quilt()). Shiny app (run_app()) guide management-options tab.
